findings.detail: Four gated official checkpoint generation files were HTTP401; original server model directories and environment unavailable. Exact original effective settings cannot be established by script omission or settings log alone.

CodeLlama render(tokenize=False) then default tokenizer encoding adds a second BOS. Test uses the exact basic script prompt builder and formatting pipeline with official tokenizer-only files and records current library version. Historical effect remains conditional; no metric impact measured.
CodeLlama is explicitly sampling .2/.95, not greedy; this matches an official example. Non-CodeLlama scripts that log DO_SAMPLE=False but do not pass it cannot be called forced greedy.
tree_few_shot/gemma-2-9b_few_shot.py actually selects Gemma3; association with manuscript table must be checked before requiring changes.
No explicit random-seed calls in these scripts. Sampling need not be invalid, but one-shot point estimates cannot establish variability or reproduce a particular random trajectory.

text=apply_chat_template(...) is computed but discarded; tokenizer.encode(prompt,add_special_tokens=False) feeds the raw prompt into model. max_len parameter is unused. This is a source-level input-format error independently of numerical temperature. No historical source hash exists to prove this exact file produced a manuscript result.

decision: Temperature alone does not require universal reruns: CodeLlama settings are valid and match official example; no active invalid zero-temperature sampling combination was found. Do not assert all runs follow fully verified official settings. Exact defaults require recovering historical local configs. A confirmed formatting discrepancy is not cured by changing temperature prose; evaluate historical tokenizer and consider targeted input-format sensitivity reruns before strong cross-model or prompt-effect claims. The current Gemma2 hierarchical-zero-shot code also discards the rendered template and encodes raw prompt. If this path produced the manuscript result, prose changes alone do not establish validity; recover run provenance and perform a targeted corrected-format check.

tokenizer_reproduction_summary.historical_limit: Original server tokenizer revision and transformers version are unavailable; the reproduction confirms current official tokenizer behavior, not the historical server runtime.
